item.title: Ep 3 · Post Missam ad tabernam · Latin only × 3
item.description: Sunday: Mass with the family, then the pub, where Marcus drinks only water. Is the pub after Mass a good custom? Quotes: Īte, missa est (end of the Latin Mass), In vīnō vēritās (old proverb; Pliny the Elder), Tū servāstī bonum vīnum ūsque adhūc (John 2:10). Latin only. The whole dialogue 3 times.

item.title: Ep 2 · Pīca et fīlius · Latin only × 3
item.description: A slow walk with my son, a real question (alone or with the kids?), and a magpie with a plan. Quotes: Festīnā lentē (Augustus), Sinite parvulōs venīre ad mē (Mark 10:14), Dum spīrō, spērō (Cicero's idea). Latin only. The whole dialogue 3 times.
